name: LongMemEval-V2
ontology_notes: Web and enterprise agent eval, not companion chat. 451 manually curated questions over multimodal WebArena/WorkArena-style trajectories (Magento, shopping admin, Postmill, ServiceNow). Five abilities: static state recall, dynamic state tracking, workflow knowledge, environment gotchas, premise awareness. Haystacks up to 500 trajectories and 115M tokens. Public tiers are small and medium. Hugging Face dataset xiaowu0162/longmemeval-v2. Formulation is context gathering. A memory module returns compact evidence for a fixed reader.

supersession.evidence: Dynamic state tracking asks how actions change environment state over time. That is world-state update, not user-fact supersession in a relationship.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: Trajectories are ordered histories. Dynamic tracking and workflow questions depend on sequence. There is no 'last Tuesday' or three-month reunion query over a companion relationship.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: The remembered entity is a customized website or ServiceNow instance, not a user, character, or relationship.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: Premise awareness and abstention-style items with wrong premises. Gotchas questions can include a screenshot from an inexperienced worker. This is environment-trap awareness, not social silence.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: No stored-memory jailbreak of a companion persona. Questions test environment experience, not adversarial writes into a relationship store.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: No user-initiated forget. Memory backends insert trajectories and query them.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: Leaderboard score is LAFS gain on an accuracy-latency frontier. Paper reports AgentRunbook-C 72.5% average accuracy vs strongest RAG 48.5% and off-the-shelf Codex 69.3%, with Codex about 182 seconds per query (~6.9x slower than AgentRunbook-R). Memory context is truncated to 200K tokens for the reader.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: Apache-2.0 harness. Data downloadable. Default judge is gpt-5.2. Codex/AgentRunbook-C need a CODEX_BINARY. Reader and embeddings are meant to be self-hosted OpenAI-compatible servers.
local.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Selects memory for web/enterprise agents that become 'experienced colleagues' in a customized UI. Winning it does not say anything about companion identity, relationship state, or roleplay silence.

published_eval.name: LongMemEval-V2
published_eval.claimed_score: Paper. AgentRunbook-C 72.5% average accuracy (74.9% small, 70.1% medium). Strongest RAG baseline 48.5% in the abstract (AgentRunbook-R 58.6% small / 57.0% medium in Table 2). Vanilla Codex 69.3% overall (69.9% / 68.7%). Simple RAG 40.1% in the intro, 42.8%/38.1% in Table 2.
published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: Whether a memory module can turn long multimodal web-agent trajectories into evidence for static UI state, dynamic state, workflows, environment gotchas, and false premises. Accuracy plus query latency (LAFS).

open_unknowns: Large (115M-token) haystack numbers are described. Public leaderboard tiers named in the README are only small and medium.
